name: Kumone Ayame
source:
Leader of the black-haired girl corps. She has excellent grades and is good at both literary and military arts. She plays the role of escort by welcoming the main character, Kaoru, as a member of the black-haired girl corps.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=113901&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
